_comment: Adopter rules for the careful guard. ADDITIVE ONLY: every list here is added to the
defaults in check-careful.py; nothing in this file can remove a default.
Edit this file BEFORE `adopt.py --register-guard`. Once the guard is registered it is a
guarded file: the agent is denied, and a human makes the change.
protected_branches  force-push or delete -> deny. fnmatch patterns (release/*).
db_clients          commands that can execute SQL; SQL DROP/TRUNCATE/unbounded DELETE
safe_dirs           directory names (or relative paths, fnmatch) whose recursive delete is
routine and regenerated by a tool -> silent. Relative paths only,
extra_ask           Python regexes matched against each shell command segment -> ask.
extra_deny          Python regexes matched against each shell command segment -> deny.
Invalid JSON, an unknown key or a bad regex does NOT silently drop rules: every shell
command that would have passed gets ask, naming the error. Check with:
